archetypes.name: dyn-timing-ledger
archetypes.rationale: New source-level vendor-task rows need validation across success and exception outcomes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the checks.py timing wrapper changes. Verify the helper records through the supplied Runner, uses the intended implement timing environment, suppresses timing failures, and maps exit codes consistently. Pay special attention to invalid tmpdir handling and lint-fix duplicate suppression when Claude already emitted a launcher row. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-round-window
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 round timing moved relative to post-round gates and loop continuation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 fix-applied timing deferral in review_and_fix.py. Confirm every fix-applied path records exactly one round row after post-round gates, including gate_continue and exceptions, while non-fix-applied statuses keep their prior timing behavior. Check that the new helpers do not alter terminal status or stall handling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-gantt-labels
archetypes.rationale: Task-kind allow-list and output basenames control progress report labels.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the task kind and output basename choices for the new checks timing rows. Confirm the allow-list entries are generic, match the emitted task kinds, and produce the intended Gantt labels without adding round, attempt, site, or status to the task-kind surface. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
